validation.scope: actual installed web3 and offline raw-account/RPC fixtures; no live network, Phantom, send or SBF

contract.wallet: Prefer direct wallet.publicKey + wallet.signTransaction(tx); explicit wallet.address + wallet.sign(tx,blockhash) adapter remains supported. Return a real web3 transaction or {tx: transaction}.
contract.result: signIxs returns frozen {signed: transaction, tx: transaction, blockhash, lastValidBlockHeight, expectedGenesisHash, genesisHash, feePayer}. It never sends/retries/rebuilds.
contract.rpc: Strict JSON-RPC2 matching id, result/error exclusive; bounded fetch; exactly one genesis request per check. All pin objects copied and frozen.
contract.readNeed: Passes targetTs; read defaults allow terminal states; requireOpen:true is explicit. Raw base64 decoded without global Buffer. Wrong/malformed/absent/network failures remain distinct.

notes: Mandatory genesis, safe-integer expiry checks from RPC before and after wallet; old skipGenesis/currentBlockHeight bypasses have no effect.
Signed message must equal the locally constructed one. This is not cryptographic verification of every signature; network execution remains separate.
Injected decoded chain inputs must be validated by their callers. Expected public program/ELF/authority generation checks and final source re-pin remain integration prerequisites.

Place runtime modules together in a reviewed public module directory with hashes matching their canonical source; current onchain/ is intentionally excluded by Vercel. Do not expose the onchain source tree to serve these files.
Real-web3 offline fixtures use ANV/C8 IDs; this is not deployed ANV evidence. No Phantom UI, full server-off lifecycle, live send/confirm, or SBF proof.
Svemir owns the separate send/confirm file; original Svemir bridge/read staging is untouched.
